[p-1a2b3c] SELinux blocked httpd_t (read) on /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html: wrong file label
Waiting for your decision, found by basalt on 2026-10-04 10:15 UTC

  SELinux blocked httpd_t from using /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html because
  it has the wrong label. SELinux denied httpd_t the read permission on
  /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html (labeled admin_home_t). The policy default
  there is httpd_sys_content_t; the file was probably moved or created with
  the wrong label. If you apply it, the assistant will reset the SELinux label
  of /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html to the policy default.

What will run (exactly these commands, as root, in this order)
  $ restorecon -v /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html

Risk: low (only puts back the label the policy expects).
Undo: a snapshot is taken before and after, so you can go back to the state
before the change; a rollback takes effect at the next boot.
  $ sudo basalt snapshots rollback --before p-1a2b3c

Next step
  Apply it:   sudo basalt apply p-1a2b3c
              (without a prompt: sudo basalt apply p-1a2b3c --yes --confirm eb8859af)
  Ignore it:  sudo basalt ignore p-1a2b3c

Evidence
  - raw: avc:  denied  { read } for comm="nginx" scontext=system_u:system_r:httpd_t:s0
